newsitem.title: USA: AES proceeding with 230 MW Wales plant.
newsitem.headline: AES proceeding with 230 MW Wales plant.

text.p: AES Corp said Tuesday it has given notice for TBV Power to begin construction of a 230 megawatt natural gas-fired combined cycle power plant in Barry, South Wales, United Kingdom.
This project expects to take advantage of favorable electric pricing conditions in the UK, AES said.
It said the project is expected to be operational by the second quarter of 1998, noting electric power will be sold into the National Electricity Pool.
The $150 million combined-cycle facility will be owned and operated by a subsidiary of AES Corp's AES Electric unit. The project company will initially be owned 100 percent by AES Electric.
Financing efforts for the project will begin immediately and are expected to be completed in the first quarter of 1997, the company said. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
